{{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:BN-749.png]] |name=BN-749 |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' establishes that the [[stormtrooper]]s of the [[Galactic Empire]] were all [[human]]s. |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{Rebels|Rebel Resolve}} |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Stormtrooper Corps]] **[[Lothal garrison]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|BN-749 to pilot, courier is aboard.|BN-749 reports the arrival of C1-10P|}} '''BN-749''' was the designation of a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[stormtrooper]] who served in the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper Corps]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]]. He was stationed on the [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] [[Lagos (Sentinel-class)|''Lagos'']] which was used to transport [[droid]] couriers to communications [[Starship|ships]] in orbit while all long-distance communication on the planet was disabled. When a [[Spectres|group of rebels]] replaced [[264|one]] of the couriers with their own droid [[C1-10P]], BN-749 ignored the rebel droid's lack of an escort and allowed it onboard the ''Lagos''. The shuttle then traveled to an [[Tellstar|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]] in orbit, where C1-10P successfully discovered the location of the Imperial prisoner [[Kanan Jarrus]] and escaped. ==Biography== {{Quote|There's the courier, where's his escort?''"
"''Not our problem, we're running late as it is.|BN-749 dismisses his partner's concerns|}} The [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[stormtrooper]] designated BN-749 served the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Stormtrooper Corps]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] around five [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]].''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' After a group of [[Spectres|rebels]] active on Lothal managed to [[Raid on the communications tower|hijack]] the planet's [[Imperial Communications Center]] and use it to broadcast anti-Imperial propaganda, [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] had the structure destroyed,{{Rebels|Call to Action}} disabling all long-distance communication on Lothal. This forced the Imperials on Lothal to start using [[Imperial Press Corps]] [[astromech droid]]s as couriers. BN-749 was assigned to the [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] [[Lagos (Sentinel-class)|''Lagos'']], which was responsible for transporting the [[droid]] couriers from Lothal's surface to communications [[Starship|ships]] in orbit. Hoping to learn the location of their crew mate [[Kanan Jarrus]] who had been captured by the Empire, the rebels who had hijacked the tower captured one of the Empire's droid couriers and stunned its escort. They replaced the Imperial droid, who was designated [[264]], with their own astromech, the [[C1-series astromech droid]] [[C1-10P]], who was painted to resemble the courier. When C1-10P arrived at the landing bay where the ''Lagos'' was parked, BN-749 and another stormtrooper were standing guard at the ship's entry ramp. As the astromech approached the other stormtrooper questioned why the astromech was not accompanied by an escort, but as the ''Lagos'' was already running late BN-749 ignored the issue and allowed the droid onboard. The ''Lagos'' then transported the two stormtroopers and C1-10P to a communications vessel in orbit, where the droid managed to download information regarding Jarrus's whereabouts before escaping through an airlock into space where he was picked up by the rebel vessel ''[[Ghost]]''. ==Personality and traits== BN-749 was willing to ignore C1-10P's lack of an escort due to the fact the ''Lagos'' was already running late. ==Equipment== BN-749 wore standard [[stormtrooper armor]] and carried an [[E-11 medium blaster rifle|E-11]] [[blaster rifle]]. ==Behind the scenes== BN-749 first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode ''[[Rebel Resolve]]'', which aired in [[2015]]. This stormtrooper was voiced by [[Keith Szarabajka]], who voices [[Cikatro Vizago]]. ==Appearances== *''[[Battle to the End]]'' *{{Rebels|Rebel Resolve}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=BN-749 |es=BN-749 |fr=BN-749 |ja=BN-749 |nl=BN-749 |pl=BN-749 }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Lothal Imperial Garrison members]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire]]
